selection_contract.trigger: An explicit task completion successfully saved; not task import, restore, external synchronization, notification read, or rollback.
selection_contract.ordinary: One completion, at least one incomplete task remains.
selection_contract.batch: Two or more completions merged, at least one incomplete task remains.
selection_contract.allDone: No incomplete tasks remain; takes precedence over ordinary and batch.
selection_contract.character: Alternate cow and horse between feedback appearances. Merged updates stay with the current character.
selection_contract.repeat: Avoid immediately repeating the same line for the same character and category.
selection_contract.title: Use one of the title templates; render it outside the illustration. allDone single or batch may share the same title.
selection_contract.placeholders: Only count is substituted, as a positive integer from actual completed tasks. No task titles or inferred difficulty in lines.
selection_contract.motion: One short character action, then settle. Static presentation when reduced motion is requested. Never claim unfinished animation assets are full frame-by-frame animation.
